name: custom2-nvswitch-h100
description: One HGX H100 8-GPU node for hardware validation against nccl-tests and vLLM TP8 on ARC HTC htc-g059/060: 2 endpoints (TP2 on one node) behind one switch device, 450 GB/s (419.1 GiB/s) per direction per GPU (NVLink4, 18 links x 25 GB/s), 500 ns per hop. Same units as the other custom fixtures.
